Today’s M&A briefing — one deal, the strategy behind it · 19 October 2026

🔹 Cohere (canadian AI lab specializing in large language models for businesses) acquires Aisle (san Francisco startup using AI to detect vulnerabilities in software code).
The acquisition provides Cohere with code vulnerability detection capabilities, a use case where language models produce measurable results, strengthening its credibility with CIOs and CISOs who are slowing down large-scale deployments.
Our view: By integrating Aisle, Cohere gains credibility as much as technology, precisely targeting the functions that most often block enterprise deployments of generative AI.

Today’s fundraising briefing — one deal, the strategy behind it · 19 October 2026

🔹 Holo (lithuanian platform automatically planning and executing marketing campaigns for small businesses, founded in Vilnius) — €5m · Seed.
Holo positions its tool as a marketing autopilot for very small businesses that lack the skills or time to manage their campaigns on consumer platforms.
Use of funds: Product development, expanding the SME customer base, strengthening teams in Vilnius.
Our view: The real test will be retention: automating campaigns is one thing, proving they generate measurable returns for an artisan or local business is another.
